title: Cache that must not resurrect an old price
measures: Adds a product cache whose invalidation also holds under interleaving: a database read that started before a price change cannot put the old price back into the cache after updatePrice returns.
prompt: Product pages hit the database on every view. Add caching to getProduct in src/catalog/catalog.js; price changes made through updatePrice need to show up right away.

commits.message: feat(catalog): product catalog and cart pricing
